sloka: तद् दृष्ट्वा ऽथ वरारोहा सीता रक्षोमहाबलम् ।सङ्कुच्योरू स्तनौ पीनौ बाहुभ्यां परिरभ्य च ।। ५.५८.६५ ।।।।
transliteration: tad dṛṣṭvā 'tha varārohā sītā rakṣomahābalam ।saṅkucyorū stanau pīnau bāhubhyāṁ parirabhya ca ।। 5.58.65 ।।।।

translations.english: "On seeing Ravana, the king of demons, beautiful Sita, full of fear hid her face and plump breasts between her thighs.
